$source: frontend/src/styles/tokens.css, ui.css, components/Logo.tsx, components/RewardMoment.tsx. If the app changes, update this from there.
colorRules: Three surfaces carry everything: bone (default), pink (hero / reward), ink (dark: splash, map, scan, vendor heroes).
No outlines: separation is flat colour on flat colour. Cards are paper on bone, or ink-lifted on ink.
Pink never sits on pink: on a pink ground the seal, buttons and the logo's inner chevron go ink.
Pink is the accent, not the background of everything; most of a screen is bone or ink.

font.files: brand/fonts/ (Regular 400, Medium 500, SemiBold 600, Bold 700, ExtraBold 800); includes the ₹ glyph

headline.note: login 'Get paid to explore your city.'

beat.note: 'Show up. / Do the task. / Get paid.'

type.scaleNote: Sizes are for a 390px-wide phone. For a 1080px-wide video frame multiply by ~2.77; headlines can go bigger.

shapes.hero: full-bleed colour block, bottom corners rounded 28px; content below overlaps it by ~16px
shapes.panel: paper card, 28px radius, hairline #DDD8CE dividers inside, no border
shapes.button: pill (999px), 56px tall, weight 700; pink with ink text, or ink with bone text
shapes.roundButton: pink circle with an ink arrow (login)
shapes.tabBar: floating ink pill at the bottom, 6px inset; active tab is a pink pill
shapes.badgeLive: pink pill, ink dot + 'LIVE', 11px bold caps
shapes.unitChip: small rounded chip after a figure (USDC in the app; hidden in the video, where ₹ prefixes the number)

motion.screenEnter: fade in + rise 8px, base duration, easeOut
motion.taskTick: row fills pink-soft (240ms easeOut), check circle fills ink with a spring pop (200ms); the tasks hero deepens from pink-soft to full pink as the list fills

rewardMoment.seal: 84px ink circle with pink check: scale 0.2 + rotate -18deg -> overshoot 1.18 / +5deg -> 0.95 / -2deg -> 1; 720ms spring, 100ms delay
rewardMoment.rings: three 2px ink rings scale 0.8 -> 2.6 while fading 0.5 -> 0; 1600ms easeOut; delays 300 / 620 / 940ms
rewardMoment.burst: 14 circles (5, 7, 10px; alternating ink and bone) fly out 86-138px; 1100ms easeOut; delays 300-435ms
rewardMoment.countUp: 0 -> amount over 850ms, ease-out cubic, starts at 420ms; settles on the exact figure

rules: Never alter the chevron paths, the 12deg rotation or the stroke width.
Default: ink outer, pink inner (on bone/white). Reversed: bone outer, pink inner (on ink). On pink: bone outer, ink inner.
Below 20px use the mono mark: the pink inner chevron stops reading.
Lockup gap = 25% of mark width; wordmark = 75% of mark size, ExtraBold, -0.045em.

voice.tagline: Get paid to explore your city.
voice.style: Short, plain, confident sentences ending in full stops. Second person. No hype words, no exclamation marks.
examples: Point at the code in store.
